thread:
Maya R: noticed Datadog ingestion alert — payloads from partner-ingest show encrypted blobs and KMS key metadata in raw logs. looks like bodies were not redacted during a recent forwarder change.
Evan (oncall): are we seeing any plaintext or decrypt attempts?
Maya R: just wrapped ciphertext + keyVersion id and algorithm header. nothing decrypted in our environment yet.
Priya S: tagging infra. did we push any change to the kafka->dd pipeline in the last 24h?
infra-bot: deploy: kafka-dd-forwarder v2.14 rolled at 2026-03-20T09:07Z by ci/deploy-bot.
infra-bot: change-log: added passthrough of all message headers to support partner tracing.
Priya S: that passthrough might have missed a redact rule. I'll pause the forwarder and revert headers. running `kubectl -n logging set env deploy/kafka-dd-forwarder REDACT_BODIES=true`
Evan (oncall): pausing and reverting now. also noting timeframe so we can scope logs.
LogBot: Alert created: sec/4991234567 - potential KMS-ciphertext in logs. matched 2026-03-20T09:07:12 -> 2026-03-20T09:28:40.
Maya R: partner key path in blob: `projects/redwood-prod/locations/us/keyRings/external/cryptoKeys/partnerA-ingest::v3`. includes key version id v3.
Evan (oncall): good. immediate plan: 1) pause forwarding (Priya), 2) revoke any ephemeral unwrap grants (me), 3) scrub logs and replace ciphertext lines (Priya/infra), 4) request partner rotate, 5) add guardrails (Maya/Evan). owners?
Priya S: forwarder paused. adding a pipeline filter to strip bodies before we unpause. will test on staging.
Evan (oncall): checking IAM for recent grants on that key. running `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood-prod/...`
Evan (oncall): found a short-lived grant to `ext-ci-sa@partnera-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` created 2026-03-20T09:06:50 by deploy pipeline. revoking now.
Maya R: do we know if that SA had decrypt/unwrap permissions or only list/get?
Evan (oncall): policy shows `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get` and `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` on that key for the grant window. revoking all bindings and noting in ticket.
partner-ops-bot: Partner A notified via partner channel. acknowledged, investigating on their side.
Priya S: vault audit: we see partner-encrypted blobs stored in our KV but no calls to vault/transit/decrypt for those blob ids. looks like we never attempted unwrap.
Maya R: that reduces the risk of plaintext compromise. still need to rotate the KMS key and ask partner to create new key version and re-encrypt on their side.
Evan (oncall): I'll create a new primary key version (v4) and set it primary. coordinating with infra-GCP to ensure minimal downtime. ETA ~3h.
Priya S: starting log-scrub job against Datadog raw logs to redact matching base64-ciphertext patterns and known key-version tags. running script: `scripts/scrub_dd_logs --pattern "partnerA-ingest" --replace "<REDACTED_CIPHERTEXT>"`
Priya S: scrub run in prod slice complete, replaced 83 entries; output attached to ticket.
Maya R: nice. once rotated and scrubbed, we should push an audit alert for any future KMS-ciphertext regex matches. I'll add a Datadog monitor and a slack webhook.
Evan (oncall): for RBAC: adding a terraform precondition to infra-iam: deny granting `cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` to principals outside our host project unless approved via PR and security review. will open PR.
Priya S: forwarder filter validated in staging; will roll to prod once scrub completes. planning unpause in +45m.
Maya R: also add CI pipeline lint to block ephemeral grant creation without review — the deploy job created that grant automatically. maybe change pipeline to use short-lived token exchange via our internal agent rather than giving external SAs direct KMS unwrap rights.
Evan (oncall): agree. I'll draft the pipeline change.
partner-ops-bot: Partner A confirms they will rotate their side keys within 6h and will double-check there were no local unwrapping attempts.
Maya R: post-incident checklist draft: timeline, root cause (forwarder passthrough missed redaction), scope (# of log entries), key rotation confirmation (us & partner), limit ephemeral grants via TF, add datadog regex alert, CI pipeline hardening, and customer comms template.
Evan (oncall): plaintext verification: cross-check KMS and vault audit logs for any decrypt calls referencing these blob ids — none found.
Priya S: prod forwarder unpaused at 10:42UTC after scrub and filter deploy. monitoring for regression.
Maya R: lowering severity to low after rotation + scrub + revoke. prepping incident write-up now. assigning owners: evan->rbac + partner coord, priya->scrub + forwarder rollout, maya->postmortem + datadog alert.
Evan (oncall): created PR for terraform guard and opened ticket linking incident. will follow-up on pipeline changes.
Priya S: scrub report uploaded to ticket, 83 lines replaced, no errors.
Maya R: thanks all. closing thread here — continue updates on ticket #4991234567 and the incident doc. :v:
